example.query: I pull the lever, then close the gate.

tools.name: enter_command
tools.description: Commit one character action for the authoritative engine to validate and execute. Emit committed actions only, in the requested order.

instrument.description: Named instrument, or the literal string none when the character acts without a separate instrument.

target.description: Target of the action; resolve pronouns from the query.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Simulate one hypothetical character action without changing actual game state. For a hypothetical sequence, carry simulated changes forward within that sequence. A check does not authorize execution.

instrument.description: Named instrument, or the literal string none when the character acts without a separate instrument.

target.description: Target of the action; resolve pronouns from the query.

example.reasoning:
'pull the lever' -> action 'pull', target 'lever', instrument 'none' -> (instrument:action:target) none:pull:lever
[then]
'close the gate' -> action 'close', target 'gate', instrument 'none' -> (instrument:action:target) none:close:gate
'I pull' and 'close' -> committed action -> enter_command
none:pull:lever [before] none:close:gate
none:pull:lever -> none:close:gate
